intro: Everything you need to get started with your NES Classic, from the console itself to controllers and useful accessories.

_fields.id: Unique short id, lowercase letters, digits and dashes (for example console-ebay-1).
_fields.name: Product name as it should appear on the card.
_fields.category: One of the category ids above: console, controllers, power, storage, setup.
_fields.seller: Who sells it, for example eBay or Amazon (shown as: Sold by <seller> on <platform>).
_fields.url: Full link to the listing. Must start with https:// or the product is skipped.
_fields.compatibility: Compatibility notes; may be an empty string.
_fields.image: Optional. A relative path under img/ only (for example img/console.jpg). Leave empty for no image.
_fields.affiliate: true for Amazon Associates links (adds the Paid link label and the Amazon disclosure); false otherwise.
_fields.commission_note: Optional note shown on non-affiliate cards, for example: I receive no commission on eBay purchases.
_fields.enabled: true to show the product; false to hide it (for example a sold-out eBay listing).
_fields.featured: true for the console listing shown in the featured section (category console).
_fields.recommendation: Optional short label such as Personally used.
